description: COSTS A FEW CENTS OF USDC. Pays the card URL's quote fee, which creates the order at the card provider's exact price and returns order_id, total_usdc and pay_by. The card is always issued to the agent's OWNER, in the owner's name. If the card is over the owner's limits the owner is asked on their phone (status awaiting_owner) — then do not buy. A refusal (unknown agent, over a limit, gift cards off) is free.

amount.description: Face value in the card's own currency, e.g. 25 or "12.50".

brand.description: Brand name or slug from search_gift_cards, e.g. "amazon-com".

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "USA" or "Canada".

name: quote
title: Lock a price (pays a small quote fee)
